title: Linear algebra
audience: a college student in a mathematics degree program (or a related major such as physics, computer science or economics), or an adult studying the same material on their own
purpose: Use vector spaces, linear maps and eigenvectors, and explain how coordinates depend on a basis.

blocks.deliverable: Solve systems with unique, absent and nonunique solutions.
Find bases for column space and null space.
Represent the same transformation in two bases.
Week 7 midterm; include a matrix that is not diagonalizable.
Derive least squares normal equations and interpret residuals.
Compare an eigendecomposition with an SVD.
Present the model and solve an unseen 120 minute exam.

project: Diagonalize a coupled two variable model and compare analytic and numerical evolution.
completion: finish the project, take the week 7 midterm and week 14 cumulative final, then complete a new cumulative assessment after 1 to 2 weeks. Explain one major result aloud without notes.
